combinations.readout: thermal hyperalgesia and mechanical allodynia thresholds
combinations.magnitude: BHB analgesia completely abrogated in Sirt3-/- mice
combinations.evidence_quote: Sirt3 deficiency completely abrogated BHB's analgesic effects on thermal hyperalgesia and mechanical allodynia thresholds (Figures 5B and 5C)

combinations.readout: spinal pro-inflammatory cytokines (IL-6, IL-1beta, TNF-alpha) and p-p65
combinations.magnitude: BHB-induced suppression abolished in Sirt3-/- mice
combinations.evidence_quote: abolished BHB-induced suppression of spinal pro-inflammatory cytokines (IL-6, IL-1β, TNF-α) and phosphorylated NF-κB p65 (p-p65) (Figures 5D-5F)

combinations.readout: spinal mitochondrial bioenergetics (membrane potential, mtDNA, ATP)
combinations.magnitude: BHB protective effects nullified in Sirt3 knockout
combinations.evidence_quote: Sirt3 knockout nullified BHB's protective effects on mitochondrial bioenergetics, as evidenced by impaired membrane potential restoration (Figure 6F), failure to reverse mtDNA depletion (Figure 6G), and persistent ATP synthesis deficits (Figure 6H).
